title: DOW-UAP-D082, Narrative Statement 4, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This is a memorandum for record from the Department of War containing a first-hand narrative from a federal law enforcement agent regarding UAP observations, including one specific encounter with a physical object.

encounters.summary: Witness 4, a federal law enforcement agent, observed an object darker than the sky with a static red light hovering between two mountain ridges, appearing to use terrain for concealment.
encounters.entity_appearance: object darker than the sky with a faint static red light
encounters.entity_behavior: hovering and using terrain to stay hidden
encounters.quote: This looked like an actual object and from my vantage point it seemed to be using the terrain to stay hidden.
